releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.25:
- Smart TV / 4-Digit Code Screen Pairing: Connect kitchen screens, bar displays, lobby TVs, and kiosks instantly with zero USB drives. Secondary screens display a 4-digit code (e.g. 7421) and the Main Cash Register approves with 1 click.
- Universal Hardware Setup: Standalone installer (Impossible_POS_Hardware_Setup.bat) available directly on the website and server, supporting all 10 hardware stations plus thermal printer and cash drawer service activation in one unified menu.
- Conversational Chatbot Upgrade: Integrated guidance for smart pairing, hardware setup, thermal printers, and network discovery in both English and Spanish.
- Updated Operations Manuals: Full step-by-step procedures for the new zero-friction hardware deployment.
- Zero Regressions: Verified 100% integrity across all 72 modal dialogs with 0 warnings.
